column2: The essay's diffuse structure, wandering across too many topics, left readers unsure of its main point.
column3: 這篇文章結構散漫，在太多主題間遊走，讓讀者搞不清楚重點。
column5: dif 分開 + fuse 倒，把話四處倒開，散漫不集中

column2: The film's hackneyed plot, with its mistaken identities and last-minute rescues, bored the audience.
column3: 這部電影的情節老套，充滿認錯人與最後一刻獲救的橋段，讓觀眾覺得無聊。
column5: hack 是出租馬車，被租用太多次就老舊了

column2: Her trite advice to "just be yourself" helped no one facing a real dilemma.
column3: 她那句「做自己就好」的老套建議，對面臨真正兩難的人毫無幫助。
column5: tr 像 tried，試過太多次，已經老掉牙

column2: The speech was full of banal remarks that could have been delivered at any graduation.
column3: 這場演講充滿平庸的話，放在任何畢業典禮都說得通。
column5: 諧音「爸那」：爸，那個笑話聽過了，老掉牙

column2: The platitudinous toast, "may all your dreams come true," drew polite but unenthusiastic applause.
column3: 那句老生常談的祝酒詞「願你美夢成真」，只換來禮貌但冷淡的掌聲。
column5: platitude 是平淡無奇的陳腔濫調，像 flat 一樣平

column2: After the thrill of the expedition, returning to mundane tasks like grocery shopping felt strange.
column3: 經歷刺激的探險後，回頭做買菜這類平凡瑣事，感覺很怪。
column5: mund 是世界，屬於凡間日常的事

column2: The diary records quotidian details, such as the weather, meals, and neighbors' gossip.
column3: 這本日記記錄日常瑣事，像是天氣、三餐和鄰居的閒話。
column5: quot 像 quota 每日配額，每天都有

column2: Engineers proposed a novel method for recycling plastic that required no heat.
column3: 工程師提出一種不需加熱的新穎塑膠回收方法。
column5: nov 和 new 同根，都是新的

column2: Critics lauded the young pianist for her daring interpretation of Bach.
column3: 評論家讚揚這位年輕鋼琴家對巴赫大膽的詮釋。
column4: laud a performance (讚揚一場演出)
column5: laud 近 loud，大聲喝采就是讚美

column2: The brochure extols the virtues of the region's wines in glowing terms.
column3: 這本手冊用熱烈的字眼，高度讚揚該地區葡萄酒的優點。
column4: extol the virtues (大力頌揚優點)
column5: ex 向上 + toll 舉，把人高高舉起來稱讚

column2: The principal commended the students for organizing the beach cleanup.
column3: 校長表揚學生舉辦海灘淨灘活動。
column4: commend someone for bravery (表揚某人的勇氣)
column5: recommend 去掉 re，當面推薦並稱讚

column2: At her retirement party, colleagues eulogized the librarian as the heart of the school.
column3: 在她的榮退派對上，同事盛讚這位圖書館員是學校的核心。
column4: eulogize a mentor (頌揚一位導師)
column5: eu 好 + log 言語，專說好話

column2: Critics acclaimed the debut novel as the most original work of the decade.
column3: 評論家盛讚這部處女作是十年來最具原創性的作品。
column4: acclaim a film (盛讚一部電影)
column5: ac + claim 大聲喊，大聲歡呼喝采

column2: Many cultures venerate their elders as keepers of wisdom and tradition.
column3: 許多文化敬重長者，視他們為智慧與傳統的守護者。
column5: 想像對長輩深深鞠躬，滿懷敬意

column2: Villagers revere the old oak as a symbol of their town's endurance.
column3: 村民尊崇這棵老橡樹，視它為小鎮堅韌的象徵。
column4: revere a teacher (尊崇一位老師)
column5: re 一再 + vere 敬畏，一直心懷敬畏

column2: Do not disparage rivals; let your own results speak for you.
column3: 別貶低對手，讓你自己的成果替你說話。
column4: disparage someone's work (貶低某人的作品)
column5: dis 不 + par 同等，不把人當同等看待

column2: Colleagues who belittle junior staff members' ideas often discourage honest feedback.
column3: 輕視資淺同仁想法的同事，往往讓人不敢坦白提出意見。
column4: belittle someone's effort (輕視某人的努力)
column5: be + little 小，把別人說得小小的

column2: Rival campaigns tried to denigrate her record with misleading claims.
column3: 對手陣營用誤導的說法，企圖抹黑她的政績。
column5: 想像拿墨水把別人的名聲塗黑

column2: The author deprecates her early poems as immature, although readers adore them.
column3: 作者貶低自己早期的詩作不夠成熟，但讀者都很喜愛。
column5: deprecate 貶低；別和 depreciate 貶值混淆

column2: Opponents derided the plan as naive, laughing at its optimistic budget.
column3: 反對者嘲笑這項計畫天真，取笑它樂觀的預算。
column4: deride an idea (嘲笑一個想法)
column5: 與 ridiculous 可笑的同根，de 向下嘲弄

column2: The older boys mocked his accent until he stopped speaking in class.
column3: 大男孩們一直嘲弄他的口音，直到他在課堂上不再開口。
column4: mock someone's accent (嘲弄某人的口音)
column5: mock 近「模」，模仿別人來取笑

column2: The committee censured the senator for misusing campaign funds.
column3: 委員會譴責這位參議員濫用競選經費。
column5: censor 是審查官，審查官嚴厲批評你的錯

column2: The coach castigated the team for careless mistakes after the loss.
column3: 輸球後，教練嚴厲責備球隊的粗心失誤。
column4: castigate someone publicly (公開嚴厲斥責某人)
column5: 想像老師站在講台前，嚴肅地訓話糾正

column2: Reviewers lambasted the sequel as lazy, noisy, and badly acted.
column3: 影評人痛批這部續集偷懶、吵鬧又演技拙劣。
column4: lambaste a policy (痛批一項政策)
column5: 諧音「懶巴士」：搭懶巴士遲到被老闆痛罵

column2: The inspector reprehended the contractor for ignoring basic safety rules.
column3: 檢查員斥責承包商無視基本安全規定。
column5: re 回 + prehend 抓，抓住錯處來斥責

column2: The driver berated the cyclist for ignoring the red light.
column3: 司機痛罵騎單車的人闖紅燈。
column5: 諧音「背雷」：像背後打雷一樣痛罵

column2: The teacher gently admonished the class to lock their lockers before leaving.
column3: 老師溫和地提醒全班，離開前要鎖好置物櫃。
column5: ad 向 + mon 提醒，像 monitor 班長提醒大家

column2: The coach chastised the players for arriving late, then reviewed the day's plan.
column3: 教練責備球員遲到，接著說明當天的計畫。
column5: chaste 純潔，責罰是為了讓人改正

column2: She reproved her brother for teasing the younger children.
column3: 她責備弟弟捉弄年紀更小的孩子。
column5: re 回 + prove 證明，指出你錯了而責備

column2: DNA evidence exonerated the accused man after years of suspicion.
column3: DNA 證據在多年懷疑之後，證明被告無罪。
column4: exonerate a suspect (證明嫌犯無罪)
column5: ex 去除 + onus 負擔，卸下罪責的重擔
